sources.text: 지퍼가 있는 작은 파우치를 원해요. 짙은 파란색이면 좋겠어요.
Un tablier avec des poches pour faire du pain, s’il vous plaît.

translations.englishGloss: I want a small pouch with a zipper. I'd like it to be dark blue.
An apron with pockets for making bread, please.
